scope: Original 103 acquired editions and five deferred records, expanded with individually reviewed reusable editions.

ccel-public-domain.decision: Host only the historical edition text and historical notes marked Public Domain in the individual XML DC.Rights. Exclude CCEL modern descriptions, covers and website content, which have separate rights.

historical-transcription.decision: Historical translations published 1854–1924; underlying text is public domain in the United States. Retain source attribution; omit modern web summaries.

gutenberg.decision: Catalog identifies these Whiston texts as public domain in the USA. Branding and license boilerplate are excluded from reader text; acknowledgment links remain in source records under the license’s reference/colophon allowance.

mattison.decision: Translator explicitly dedicates each translation for unrestricted copying, modification and use for any purpose.

web.decision: Official public-domain dedication permits public internet republication. Preserve the supplied text.

wesley-restricted.decision: Reference records only. Express commercial-use restrictions occur in 2 Baruch, Testament of Moses and Psalms of Solomon; public-republication rights for the two Wesley Adam-and-Eve transcriptions are not established.

dss-noncommercial.decision: Reference records only; CC BY-NC 4.0. Preserve identified witnesses and critical-mark caveats without copying restricted dataset text.

unproofread-scan.decision: Link to the published historical scan; no mixed OCR hosted or indexed as ancient text.

unacquired.decision: Catalog pointers only; no acquired edition or substitute.

other-gospels-public-domain.decision: Host only the Zinner translation edited by Mattison and the public-domain versing. The publisher dedicates these translations for unrestricted use. Exclude introductions, footnotes and commentary, website code, images, and the separately licensed Davies/Barnstone translations.
